query:
SELECT session_id AS "session_id!: Uuid",
                      seq,
                      file_id AS "file_id!: Uuid",
                      line_seq,
                      created_at AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
               FROM cli_ingest_outbox
               WHERE session_id = $1 AND seq > $2
               ORDER BY seq ASC
               LIMIT $3
